threats.attack: repository traversal, absolute paths, separator ambiguity, or symlink escape
mitigations: lstat rejection for every existing path component

threats.attack: Git ref, push-option, protocol-header, or execution argument injection
mitigations: exec arguments are arrays and reject control characters

threats.attack: object-count, transaction-byte, corrupt chunk, or byte-range overflow
mirror SSRF, embedded credentials, loopback/private literal or DNS answer, force/delete, loop replay, or destination drift
mitigations: conflict refs instead of authoritative rewrite
limitations: redirect validation is the injected HTTP transport's responsibility; no redirect-following transport ships in this package

threats.attack: malicious promisor, local metadata endpoint, corrupt promised bytes, or expired promise
mitigations: exact size and content hash before materialization
limitations: object-promise validation has no injected DNS resolver; callers must resolve and pin public addresses before fetch

threats.attack: grant widening, wrong scope, expiry, revocation, budget double-spend, reservation CAS race, or receipt replay
Nostr replay, wrong audience, expiry, oversized event, private export, or Radicle replay
provider disclosure bypass, malformed output, excessive output, or authoritative mutation
F3 archive traversal or compressed archive bomb
mitigations: F3 codec accepts JSON strings only and never extracts paths or decompresses archives
limitations: transport callers must bound input string size before decode

threats.attack: private repository archival or false remote success
mitigations: success requires succeeded plus full response
no authenticated private-ref advertisement API is shipped by the focused convergence packages
limitations: a future advertisement API must add viewer-scoped filtering before claiming this capability
